description: Establish GitHub Actions CI/CD workflows and automated test suite for dev-env adapted from holon-agentic-coder (.github/workflows/), resolving test suite collection syntax errors.
goal:
Implement GitHub Actions CI/CD pipeline and automated test suite for dev-env adapted from Holon-Agentic-Coder/holon-agentic-coder:
1. WORKFLOW ARCHITECTURE: Create .github/workflows/ with:
   - make.yml: Multi-OS workflow (ubuntu-latest, macos-latest) validating 'uname -m', 'make help', and 'make check'.
   - test-hygiene.yml: Hygiene workflow on ubuntu-latest verifying uv.lock currency ('uv lock --check', 'git diff --exit-code uv.lock'), dependency sync ('uv sync --locked --extra test'), Ruff lint ('uv run ruff check .'), Prettier markdown formatting ('npx prettier --check "**/*.md"'), and ansible-lint ('uv run --extra test ansible-lint').
   - test-unit.yml: Multi-OS unit test workflow (ubuntu-latest, macos-latest) using astral-sh/setup-uv, running 'uv run --extra test pytest -v -l --tb=short -m "not network"'.
   - test-network.yml: Scheduled/manual or PR workflow running 'DEVENV_NETWORK_TESTS=1 uv run --extra test pytest -m network'.
   - .github/workflows/README.md: Documenting all CI/CD workflows, runners, triggers, and recommended branch protection status checks.
2. FIX TEST SUITE ERRORS: Fix syntax error in tests/test_templating.py (unmatched closing parenthesis on line 228) so pytest collects and runs all unit tests cleanly.
3. VERIFICATION: Ensure all local checks pass:
   - 'uv run --extra test pytest -m "not network"'
   - 'uv run ruff check .'
   - 'npx prettier --check "**/*.md"'
   - 'make check'

description: Make GNU Stow an explicit prerequisite for dotfile management, move all dotfiles into per-tool Stow packages (bash, conda, fish, nvim, tmux, zsh) including the updated Neovim config and bash/zsh configs with .local override hooks, and explicitly list all prerequisites and packages in README.md.
goal:
Move all dotfiles into per-tool GNU Stow packages under dotfiles/, enforce stow as a prerequisite for managing dotfiles, bring in the updated host Neovim config from .cache/host-nvim/, manage .bash_profile, .bashrc, and .zshrc with Stow, and explicitly list all prerequisites and packages in README.md:
1. STOW AS EXPLICIT PREREQUISITE & PACKAGE MANIFEST:
   - Add 'stow' to devenv_packages_core in ansible/group_vars/all.yml, and map 'stow: stow' in both ansible/vars/pkg_brew.yml and ansible/vars/pkg_apt.yml (installed by the packages role before the dotfiles role runs in ansible/site.yml).
   - Probe 'stow' in Makefile's `check` target (non-fatal warning if not yet installed so CI `make check` passes on fresh runners), and enforce `command -v stow` before running `make dotfiles` or `make unlink`.
   - At the start of both ansible/roles/dotfiles/tasks/main.yml and ansible/playbooks/unlink.yml, locate `stow` (`command -v stow`) and assert `stow` is present on PATH with a clear failure message if missing (stow is a hard prerequisite for managing dotfiles).
2. PER-TOOL STOW PACKAGE LAYOUT (`devenv_stow_packages: [bash, conda, fish, nvim, tmux, zsh]`):
   - Ensure zero files live directly under dotfiles/ outside a declared Stow package directory (remove legacy dotfiles/.config and dotfiles/.condarc paths).
   - `bash` package (`dotfiles/bash/`):
     - `dotfiles/bash/.bashrc` (dest `{{ devenv_home }}/.bashrc`): Multi-OS bash config using `case "$(uname -s)" in Darwin)` for Homebrew `brew shellenv` (`/opt/homebrew/bin/brew` or `/usr/local/bin/brew`) and `Linux)` for Linuxbrew, prepending `$XDG_DATA_HOME/nvm/current/bin` and `$HOME/.local/bin`, appending `$HOME/.docker/bin`, `$HOME/.lmstudio/bin`, `$HOME/.antigravity-ide/antigravity-ide/bin` when present, probing conda candidates (`$HOME/miniforge3`, `/opt/homebrew/Caskroom/miniforge/base`, etc.) for `conda shell.bash hook`, initializing SDKMAN (`$HOME/.sdkman` or `brew --prefix sdkman-cli` under Darwin guard), and sourcing `[ -f "$HOME/.bashrc.local" ] && . "$HOME/.bashrc.local"` at the end (no hardcoded `/Users/...` paths).
     - `dotfiles/bash/.bash_profile` (dest `{{ devenv_home }}/.bash_profile`): sources `[ -f "$HOME/.bashrc" ] && . "$HOME/.bashrc"` and `[ -f "$HOME/.bash_profile.local" ] && . "$HOME/.bash_profile.local"`.
   - `zsh` package (`dotfiles/zsh/`):
     - `dotfiles/zsh/.zshrc` (dest `{{ devenv_home }}/.zshrc`): Multi-OS zsh config using `case "$(uname -s)" in Darwin)` for Homebrew `brew shellenv` and `Linux)` for Linuxbrew, prepending `$XDG_DATA_HOME/nvm/current/bin` and `$HOME/.local/bin`, appending `$HOME/.docker/bin`, `$HOME/.lmstudio/bin`, `$HOME/.antigravity-ide/antigravity-ide/bin` when present, probing conda candidates for `conda shell.zsh hook`, initializing SDKMAN (`$HOME/.sdkman` or `brew --prefix sdkman-cli` under Darwin guard), and sourcing `[ -f "$HOME/.zshrc.local" ] && . "$HOME/.zshrc.local"` at the end (no hardcoded `/Users/...` paths).
   - `conda` package (`dotfiles/conda/`):
     - `dotfiles/conda/.condarc` (dest `{{ devenv_home }}/.condarc`)
   - `fish` package (`dotfiles/fish/`):
     - `dotfiles/fish/.config/fish/config.fish` (dest `{{ devenv_home }}/.config/fish/config.fish`)
     - `dotfiles/fish/.config/fish/fish_plugins` (dest `{{ devenv_home }}/.config/fish/fish_plugins`)
     - `dotfiles/fish/.config/fish/conf.d/00-devenv.fish` (dest `{{ devenv_home }}/.config/fish/conf.d/00-devenv.fish`)
   - `nvim` package (`dotfiles/nvim/`):
     - Copy the staged host Neovim config from `.cache/host-nvim/` in this workspace into `dotfiles/nvim/.config/nvim/` (`init.lua`, `nvim-pack-lock.json`, `.stylua.toml`, `lua/custom/plugins/{init,diffview,render-markdown}.lua`, and `lua/kickstart/{health.lua,plugins/{autopairs,debug,indent_line,lint,neo-tree}.lua}`). Note: do NOT copy `.git` or `.github` from `.cache/host-nvim/`.
     - List every tracked file under `dotfiles/nvim/.config/nvim/` in `devenv_links` in `ansible/group_vars/all.yml`.
   - `tmux` package (`dotfiles/tmux/`):
     - `dotfiles/tmux/.config/tmux/tmux.conf` (dest `{{ devenv_home }}/.config/tmux/tmux.conf`)
   - Declare `devenv_stow_packages: [bash, conda, fish, nvim, tmux, zsh]` in `ansible/group_vars/all.yml` and update `devenv_links` for all managed files.
3. ANSIBLE DOTFILES ROLE & UNLINK PLAYBOOK (`stow --no-folding`):
   - In `ansible/roles/dotfiles/tasks/main.yml`:
     - Assert `stow` is available and validate every `devenv_links` source file.
     - Ensure parent directories exist, move unmanaged non-symlink real files at `item.dest` into `{{ devenv_backup_dir }}`, and remove any stale symlink at `item.dest` whose resolved target is not the new Stow package file so `stow` never fails on an older symlink.
     - Replace the `ansible.builtin.file` symlink loop with `stow --no-folding --restow -v -d "{{ devenv_repo_root }}/dotfiles" -t "{{ devenv_home }}" {{ devenv_stow_packages | join(' ') }}` (passing `-n` during `ansible_check_mode`, detecting changes cleanly via `changed_when` on stderr `LINK:`/`UNLINK:` output).
     - Update post-condition symlink assertions in `ansible/roles/dotfiles/tasks/main.yml` and `ansible/playbooks/unlink.yml` to accept Stow's relative symlinks (verifying `item.stat.islnk` and checking `(item.stat.path | realpath)` or resolved target against `devenv_repo_root`).
   - In `ansible/playbooks/unlink.yml`:
     - Assert `stow` is available, verify existing managed symlinks resolve into `devenv_repo_root`, and invoke `stow --delete -v -d "{{ devenv_repo_root }}/dotfiles" -t "{{ devenv_home }}" {{ devenv_stow_packages | join(' ') }}`.
4. EXPLICIT PREREQUISITES & PACKAGES DOCUMENTATION (`README.md` & WORLD DOCS):
   - Update `README.md`, `holon-config/world/constraints.md`, and `holon-config/world/ruleset.md` to document bare `.git` + worktree repo layout (`dev-env/.git`, `dev-env/main`, `dev-env/<worktree>`), `stow` as a prerequisite for dotfiles, per-tool Stow packages managed via `stow --no-folding`, and `.local` override hooks (`.bashrc.local`, `.bash_profile.local`, `.zshrc.local`, `conf.d/*.fish`).
   - Add complete reference tables in `README.md` listing every prerequisite and tool checked or installed:
     a) Prerequisites & Bootstrap Tooling: cold-start host prerequisites checked by `make check` (`GNU Make >= 3.81`, `git`, `curl`, `apt-get` on Linux); bootstrap tools checked by `make check` and installed by `make bootstrap` (`uv`, `ansible-core` on Python 3.13, `ansible-lint` on Python 3.13, `community.general >= 9.0.0`); dotfiles prerequisite (`stow` / GNU Stow); package managers & optional GUI casks (`Homebrew` / `brew`, optional `docker-desktop` cask via `devenv_install_gui_casks`).
     b) Core CLI Packages (`devenv_packages_core`): all 22 logical packages (`aria2`, `autossh`, `curl`, `delta`, `fd`, `fish`, `fzf`, `gh`, `git`, `htop`, `iperf3`, `jq`, `ncdu`, `neovim`, `openssh`, `ripgrep`, `rsync`, `stow`, `tmux`, `tree`, `unzip`, `watch`) with macOS (`brew`) formula, Debian/Ubuntu (`apt`) package, and OS notes.
     c) Runtimes, Tools, & Plugins: Python & `uv` tools (`CPython 3.13`, `ruff`, `pre-commit`); Conda (`Miniforge3` at `~/miniforge3` + `dev` env with `python=3.13`); Node.js (`22.23.2` via `nvm.fish`); Fish plugins (`jorgebucaran/fisher`, `reitzig/sdkman-for-fish@v2.1.0`, `jorgebucaran/nvm.fish`); all 26 locked Neovim plugins from `nvim-pack-lock.json`; and `devenv_packages_remove` (`nvm`, `node`).
5. UPDATE REFERENCES, `.gitignore`, AND TESTS:
   - Update path references in `ansible/roles/node/tasks/main.yml` (`dotfiles/fish/.config/fish/conf.d/00-devenv.fish`), `ansible/roles/neovim/tasks/main.yml`, `ansible/roles/conda/tasks/main.yml`, and `dotfiles/fish/.config/fish/config.fish`.
   - Update `.gitignore` entries for `dotfiles/fish/.config/fish/{local/,fish_variables,completions/,functions/,conf.d/sdk.fish,conf.d/nvm.fish}`.
   - Update `tests/test_manifest.py` and `tests/test_templating.py`:
     - Update paths to `dotfiles/fish/.config/fish/...` and `dotfiles/nvim/.config/nvim/...`.
     - Update `test_dotfiles_hardcode_no_per_user_paths` so POSIX shell OS guards (`Darwin)`) as well as Fish (`case Darwin`) are accepted.
     - Update `test_nvim_lockfile_covers_every_declared_plugin` to parse both `gh 'owner/repo'` helper calls and `'https://github.com/owner/repo'` URLs across `dotfiles/nvim/.config/nvim/init.lua` and `dotfiles/nvim/.config/nvim/lua/**/*.lua` (ignoring `--` comments).
     - Add tests asserting: (a) `'stow'` is in `devenv_packages_core`, (b) `Makefile` `check` probes `stow`, (c) `devenv_stow_packages` matches `dotfiles/` subdirectories (`bash`, `conda`, `fish`, `nvim`, `tmux`, `zsh`), (d) every file under `dotfiles/` lives inside a declared Stow package and is listed in `devenv_links`, and (e) `README.md` explicitly names every logical package in `devenv_packages_core`, every tool in `devenv_uv_tools`, every plugin in `fish_plugins`, and every plugin in `nvim-pack-lock.json`.
6. VERIFICATION:
   - `uv run --extra test pytest -m "not network"`
   - `uv run ruff check .`
   - `uv run --extra test ansible-lint ansible/site.yml`
   - `npx prettier --check "**/*.md"`
   - `make check`

description: Enforce the pure make -> conda -> ansible bootstrap chain (GNU Make is the sole cold-start prerequisite; git/curl are deferred to Ansible; all Python/Ansible/app-dev installs including uv are done through Conda), add multi-variant Stow packages and the host interactive pre-Ansible wizard (make configure + scripts/devenv_wizard.py), and rework README.md so the tool chain, prerequisites, and packages are blindingly obvious.
goal:
Implement the pure `make -> conda -> ansible` bootstrap tool chain, multi-variant GNU Stow packages, host interactive pre-Ansible wizard, and comprehensive `README.md` rework:
1. PURE `make -> conda -> ansible` TOOL CHAIN (NO `git`, `curl`, OR `uv` COLD-START PREREQUISITE):
   - SOLE COLD-START PREREQUISITE (`GNU Make >= 3.81`): `make` MUST always be available for ANY action in `dev-env`. Do NOT require `git`, `curl`, or `uv` as cold-start prerequisites in `make check` (`git` and `curl` checks/installs are deferred to Ansible's `packages` role; `uv` is NOT required for installation at all and is installed purely for application development).
   - `make bootstrap` — Step 1 (Ensure Conda `~/miniforge3/bin/conda`): Define `CONDA_DIR ?= $(HOME)/miniforge3` and `CONDA ?= $(CONDA_DIR)/bin/conda`. If `$(CONDA)` is missing, resolve the platform Miniforge3 installer (`Miniforge3-MacOSX-arm64.sh`/`x86_64` on Darwin, `Miniforge3-Linux-aarch64.sh`/`x86_64` on Linux), download it from `https://github.com/conda-forge/miniforge/releases/latest/download/$$installer` using whichever fetcher exists (`curl`, `wget`, or system `python3` `urllib.request`) into `$$HOME/.cache/dev-env/`, and install Miniforge3 into `$(CONDA_DIR)` (`-b -u -p "$(CONDA_DIR)"`).
   - `make bootstrap` — Step 2 (Conda installs Ansible & Python bootstrap tooling): Run `"$(CONDA)" install -y -c conda-forge --override-channels python=3.13 ansible-core ansible-lint pyyaml`. Shim `$(CONDA_DIR)/bin/ansible-playbook`, `$(CONDA_DIR)/bin/ansible-galaxy`, and `$(CONDA_DIR)/bin/ansible-lint` into `~/.local/share/dev-env/bin/` (`$(PB)`, `$(GALAXY)`, `$(LINT)`), and install `community.general` via `$(GALAXY) collection install -r "$(SELF_DIR)/ansible/requirements.yml" --force`. NEVER use `curl https://astral.sh/uv/install.sh` or `uv tool install` anywhere in `Makefile`.
   - `make check` probes the chain clearly in dependency order: `GNU Make` (hard prerequisite) -> `OS` -> `apt` (Linux backend check) -> `conda` -> `ansible-core` -> `community.general` -> `stow` -> `brew` (macOS) -> `git`/`curl` (deferred to Ansible `packages` role, informational only so `make check` never fails if `git` or `curl` is absent).
   - Keep `Makefile` 100% GNU Make 3.81 compatible (no `.ONESHELL`, `$(file`, `!=`, `.RECIPEPREFIX`). Keep CI test commands (`make test`, `make test-all`) working cleanly on both Conda Python and CI `uv` runners.
   - `ansible/site.yml` & `ansible/roles/uv/tasks/main.yml`: Run `conda` BEFORE `uv` (`bootstrap -> homebrew -> packages -> dotfiles -> conda -> uv -> node -> neovim -> fish`). In `ansible/roles/uv/tasks/main.yml`, remove all `astral.sh/uv/install.sh` and `uv tool install` tasks; instead install `uv` and `devenv_uv_tools` (`ruff`, `pre-commit`) directly via Conda (`"{{ devenv_conda_dir }}/bin/conda" install -y -c conda-forge --override-channels uv {{ devenv_uv_tools | join(' ') }}`) purely as application-development tools for the user, and assert `{{ devenv_conda_dir }}/bin/uv` exists.
2. MULTI-VARIANT STOW PACKAGES (`devenv_package_variants`):
   - Declare `devenv_package_variants` in `ansible/group_vars/all.yml` mapping configurable tools (starting with `nvim`, extensible to other tools) to a default variant and Stow package directories:
     - `nvim-kickstart` (`dotfiles/nvim-kickstart/.config/nvim/...` — migrated from `dotfiles/nvim/`)
     - `nvim-minimal` (`dotfiles/nvim-minimal/.config/nvim/...` — lightweight built-in `vim.pack` config)
     - `nvim-lazyvim` (`dotfiles/nvim-lazyvim/.config/nvim/...` — LazyVim starter config)
   - Keep `devenv_stow_packages`, `devenv_links`, and `devenv_skip_links` (default `[]`) consistent across all declared variants.
   - In `ansible/roles/bootstrap/tasks/main.yml`, load `~/.config/dev-env/choices.yml` when present (`stat` + `ansible.builtin.include_vars`) while CI/non-interactive runs fall back to `group_vars/all.yml` defaults.
   - In `ansible/roles/dotfiles/tasks/main.yml` and `ansible/playbooks/unlink.yml`, unstow inactive variants (`stow --delete`) before stowing active packages (`stow --no-folding --restow`), and respect `devenv_skip_links`.
   - Update `ansible/roles/neovim/tasks/main.yml` so plugin checks respect the active `nvim` variant.
3. HOST INTERACTIVE PRE-ANSIBLE WIZARD (`scripts/devenv_wizard.py` & `Makefile`):
   - Implement `scripts/devenv_wizard.py` (Python 3.13, no `.sh` files) supporting `--non-interactive`, `--choices-file`, `--home`, and `--repo-root` flags, collecting all human-required decisions before Ansible runs:
     - Step A (OS / Distro & Backend Confirmation): detect OS, arch, Linux `/etc/os-release`, and package backend (`brew` / `apt`), confirm or override.
     - Step B (Stow Package Enablement & Config Distro / Variant Selection): select active Stow packages (`bash`, `conda`, `fish`, `nvim`, `tmux`, `zsh`) and multi-variant choices (`nvim`: `kickstart`, `minimal`, `lazyvim`) via `fzf` on TTY or numbered `/dev/tty` menu.
     - Step C (Interactive Dotfile Conflict Resolution & Merge): scan target paths in `$HOME`; when a regular file differs from the repo's Stow package file, prompt per file: `[d]` diff (`delta` / `diff -u`), `[m]` interactive merge (`nvim -d` / `$EDITOR -d` on `/dev/tty`, then back up `$HOME/<file>`), `[l]` extract to `.local` override (`~/.bashrc.local`, `~/.bash_profile.local`, `~/.zshrc.local`, `~/.config/fish/conf.d/99-local.fish`), `[a]` adopt into repo & back up `$HOME/<file>`, `[b]` back up `$HOME/<file>` & use repo version, `[s]` skip (`devenv_skip_links`).
     - Step D (Host Feature Flags & Runtime Pins): prompt for `devenv_set_login_shell`, `devenv_install_gui_casks` & `devenv_casks`, `devenv_remove_unmanaged` (when conflicting packages like `brew node`/`brew nvm` are detected), and confirm/override `devenv_python_version`, `devenv_conda_env_python`, `devenv_node_default_version`.
     - Step E (Persist Choices): write `~/.config/dev-env/choices.yml` (`0600`/`0644`).
   - Add `make configure` in `Makefile` running `$(CONDA_DIR)/bin/python3 scripts/devenv_wizard.py` (with fallback to `python3` if needed), and have `make install` run `configure` automatically on interactive TTYs (`[ -t 0 ]` and `CI != true`) when `~/.config/dev-env/choices.yml` is absent.
4. BLINDINGLY OBVIOUS TOOL CHAIN & COMPLETE PACKAGE INVENTORY IN `README.md`:
   - Put the **Chain of Tools & Execution Order** front and centre at the top of `README.md` (visual diagram + stage-by-stage table):
     - **Sole Prerequisite (`GNU Make >= 3.81`):** required for ANY action (`git`, `curl`, and `uv` are NOT cold-start prerequisites; `git` and `curl` are deferred to Ansible, and `uv` is purely an application-dev tool installed via Conda).
     - **Step 1 (`make bootstrap` -> Conda -> Ansible):** `make` installs **Conda** (`~/miniforge3`), and **Conda** installs `python=3.13`, `ansible-core`, `ansible-lint`, `pyyaml`, and `community.general`.
     - **Step 2 (`make configure` -> Interactive Wizard):** Conda Python runs `scripts/devenv_wizard.py` -> saves `~/.config/dev-env/choices.yml`.
     - **Step 3 (`make converge` -> Ansible):** Ansible runs `bootstrap` -> `homebrew`/`packages` (installs 22 CLI tools including `git`, `curl`, `stow`) -> `dotfiles` (requires `stow`; links via `stow --no-folding`) -> `conda` (`dev` env) -> `uv` (installs `uv`, `ruff`, `pre-commit` via Conda for app dev) -> `node` -> `neovim` -> `fish`.
   - Explicitly list all prerequisites by stage, valid bare-repo worktree clone commands (`dev-env/.git`, `dev-env/main`, `dev-env/<worktree>`), Quick Start & Day-to-Day commands, complete tables of all installed/configured packages (all 22 `devenv_packages_core` packages with `brew`/`apt` names & Stow status, runtimes & Conda-installed app-dev Python tools, Stow packages & variants, 3 Fish plugins, 26 locked Neovim plugins, GUI casks, purged duplicates), Interactive Setup & Merge guide, and Architecture/CI.
5. TESTS & WORLD DOCS:
   - Update `holon-config/world/ruleset.md` and `holon-config/world/constraints.md` to reflect pure `make -> conda -> ansible` bootstrap (removing the `uv tool install --python 3.13` rule so world rules match the new architecture), `scripts/devenv_wizard.py`, and `devenv_package_variants`.
   - Add unit tests in `tests/test_wizard.py` covering OS/distro detection & confirmation, variant resolution, conflict detection, diff/merge/local-extract/adopt/backup/skip flows, runtime pin & flag overrides, choices persistence, and non-interactive fallback.
   - Update `tests/test_manifest.py` and `tests/test_templating.py` to assert: (a) `astral.sh/uv/install.sh` and `uv tool install` do NOT appear in `Makefile` or `ansible/roles/uv/tasks/main.yml`, (b) `conda` runs before `uv` in `ansible/site.yml`, (c) `Makefile` `check` probes `GNU Make` and `conda` without failing when `git`/`curl`/`uv` are absent, (d) `devenv_package_variants` invariants across all variants, and (e) `README.md` names every prerequisite, core package, Conda app-dev Python tool (`uv`, `ruff`, `pre-commit`), Stow package/variant, Fish plugin, and Neovim plugin.
6. VERIFICATION:
   - `uv run --extra test pytest -m "not network"` (and verify `conda`/system python compatibility)
   - `uv run ruff check .`
   - `uv run --extra test ansible-lint ansible/site.yml`
   - `npx prettier --check "**/*.md"`
   - `make check`

description: Keep dev-env bootstrap as minimal as possible by fetching Miniforge3 using only curl, installing curl via brew (macOS) or apt (Linux) if missing, removing wget and python3 download fallbacks, and using apt everywhere instead of apt-get.
goal:
Simplify make bootstrap in dev-env to use only curl and apt (never apt-get, wget, or python3 download fallbacks):
1. MAKEFILE MINIMAL `curl`-ONLY & `apt`-ONLY BOOTSTRAP:
   - Replace all `apt-get` occurrences in `Makefile` with `apt` (lines 42 & 83 `apt install -y make`, and `check` probing `command -v apt >/dev/null 2>&1`).
   - In `Makefile` (`bootstrap` target), remove the `wget` and `python3 urllib.request` fallbacks completely.
   - When `$(CONDA)` is missing and `$$target` does not exist yet:
     - Check `command -v curl >/dev/null 2>&1`.
     - If `curl` is missing:
       - On `Darwin`: locate `brew` (`/opt/homebrew/bin/brew`, `/usr/local/bin/brew`, or `command -v brew`) and run `"$$brew_bin" install curl` (failing with a clear message if Homebrew is missing).
       - On `Linux`: run `apt update && apt install -y curl` (with `sudo` if `$$(id -u) -ne 0`, or directly as root).
     - Download Miniforge3 using ONLY `curl`: `curl -fsSL "$$url" -o "$$target" || exit 1`.
   - In `Makefile` (`configure` target), require `"$(CONDA_DIR)/bin/python3"` (failing with `Run 'make bootstrap' first.` if absent) instead of falling back to host `python3`, keeping Python strictly Conda-owned.
   - Keep `Makefile` 100% GNU Make 3.81 compatible (tabs on recipes, no `.ONESHELL`, `$(file`, `!=`, `.RECIPEPREFIX`).
2. REPLACE `apt-get` IN `ansible/roles/packages/tasks/main.yml`:
   - Replace `'apt-get remove -y '` with `'apt remove -y '` on line 28.
3. UPDATE `README.md` & `holon-config/world/constraints.md`:
   - Update `README.md` (Step 1: `make bootstrap` diagram and text, plus any `apt-get` references) to state that `make bootstrap` installs `curl` via `brew` (macOS) or `apt` (Linux) if absent and fetches Miniforge3 using `curl` only, removing all mentions of `wget`, `python3 urllib`, and `apt-get`.
   - Replace `apt-get install` with `apt install` in `holon-config/world/constraints.md`.
4. TESTS (`tests/test_manifest.py`):
   - Add `test_makefile_bootstrap_uses_only_curl_and_installs_curl_via_brew_or_apt()` and `test_no_apt_get_in_repo()` asserting:
     - `wget` and `urllib.request` do NOT appear in `Makefile`,
     - `apt-get` does NOT appear anywhere in `Makefile`, `ansible/roles/packages/tasks/main.yml`, `README.md`, or `holon-config/world/constraints.md`,
     - `curl -fsSL`, `install curl`, and `apt install -y curl` are present in `Makefile`'s `bootstrap` target.
5. VERIFICATION:
   - `uv run --extra test pytest -m "not network"`
   - `uv run ruff check .`
   - `uv run --extra test ansible-lint ansible/site.yml`
   - `npx prettier --check "**/*.md"`
   - `make check`

description: Make brew (macOS) and apt (Linux) the sole system prerequisites, treat uv uniformly as a standard Conda toolset package, convert the README diagram to Mermaid, remove Makefile shim symlinks and stow/git/curl checks from make check, and fix the bare-repo clone snippet.
goal:
Update dev-env across Makefile, Ansible roles, docs, world rules, and tests:
1. SYSTEM PREREQUISITES (`brew` ON macOS, `apt` ON LINUX):

   - In `Makefile` line 42 and `help:` (lines 82-84): update cold-start notes to state that `brew` (macOS) or `apt` (Debian/Ubuntu) is required, and if `make` is not installed yet, install it via `brew install make` (or `xcode-select --install`) on macOS or `sudo apt install -y make` on Linux before running `make install`.
   - In `Makefile` `check:`:
     - Probe ONLY `GNU Make`, `OS` (`Darwin|Linux`), `apt (Linux backend)`, `brew (macOS backend)`, `conda`, `ansible-core`, and `community.general`.
     - Treat BOTH `brew` (on `Darwin`) and `apt` (on `Linux`) as hard prerequisites (`err=$$((err+1))` if missing, never just `warn`):
       - On `Darwin`: `if [ -x /opt/homebrew/bin/brew ] || [ -x /usr/local/bin/brew ] || command -v brew >/dev/null 2>&1; then echo "ok"; else echo "MISSING: Homebrew (brew) is required"; err=$$((err+1)); fi`
       - On `Linux`: `if command -v apt >/dev/null 2>&1; then echo "ok"; else echo "MISSING: apt is required"; err=$$((err+1)); fi`
     - Remove `stow`, `git`, and `curl` checks from `make check` (`curl` is installed in `make bootstrap` if absent; `stow`, `git`, `curl`, etc. are converged by Ansible's `packages` role).
   - In `Makefile` `bootstrap:`:
     - Require `brew` (on `Darwin`) or `apt` (on `Linux`) to be present and fail immediately (`exit 1`) if missing (on `Darwin`: resolve `brew_bin` from `/opt/homebrew/bin/brew`, `/usr/local/bin/brew`, or `command -v brew`, and if empty print `"Error: Homebrew (brew) is required on macOS." >&2; exit 1`; on `Linux`: check `command -v apt >/dev/null 2>&1 || { echo "Error: apt is required on Linux." >&2; exit 1; }`).
     - When fetching Miniforge3 (`[ ! -f "$$target" ]`), if `! command -v curl >/dev/null 2>&1`, install `curl` using `"$$brew_bin" install curl || exit 1` on `Darwin`, or `sudo apt update && sudo apt install -y curl || exit 1` (without `sudo` when `id -u` is `0`) on `Linux`.

   - Fold `devenv_conda_tools` installation (`conda install -y -c conda-forge --override-channels {{ devenv_conda_tools | join(' ') }}`, guarded cleanly with `creates: "{{ devenv_conda_dir }}/bin/uv"`) and optional `devenv_holon_source` editable install into `ansible/roles/conda/tasks/main.yml`.

3. REMOVE `~/.local/share/dev-env/bin` SHIM SYMLINKS COMPLETELY:
   - In `Makefile`: remove `BIN := $(DEVENV_HOME)/bin` and the space-free shims comments; set `PB := $(CONDA_DIR)/bin/ansible-playbook`, `GALAXY := $(CONDA_DIR)/bin/ansible-galaxy`, `LINT := $(CONDA_DIR)/bin/ansible-lint` directly.

4. CONVERT `README.md` DIAGRAM TO MERMAID (`flowchart TD`), FIX TABLE & CLONE SNIPPET:

description: Detect existing conda installations via command -v conda, bootstrap missing conda via brew (only in make bootstrap) while Ansible keeps one package manager per OS (brew on macOS, apt on Linux), add '## Getting Started' highlighting 'make install', fix '`nvm`/node' formatting, and add Category/Language attribution for every tool in README.md.
goal:
Update Makefile, Ansible roles, README.md, world docs, and tests in dev-env in one unified flow:
1. DETECT EXISTING CONDA VIA `command -v conda` & BOOTSTRAP CONDA VIA `brew` WHEN ABSENT:
   - In `Makefile`: replace hardcoded `CONDA_DIR ?= $(HOME)/miniforge3` with GNU Make 3.81-compatible detection (`CONDA_DIR ?= $(shell ...)` without `!=`) that checks `command -v conda >/dev/null 2>&1` and resolves `conda info --base` first, then probes `/opt/homebrew/Caskroom/miniforge/base`, `/usr/local/Caskroom/miniforge/base`, and `$(HOME)/miniforge3`, and if Conda is absent falls back to `/opt/homebrew/Caskroom/miniforge/base` (Apple Silicon macOS when `/opt/homebrew` exists), `/usr/local/Caskroom/miniforge/base` (Intel macOS), or `$(HOME)/miniforge3` (Linux).
   - Keep `CONDA ?= $(shell command -v conda 2>/dev/null || echo $(CONDA_DIR)/bin/conda)` or ensure `PB := $(CONDA_DIR)/bin/ansible-playbook`, `GALAXY := $(CONDA_DIR)/bin/ansible-galaxy`, `LINT := $(CONDA_DIR)/bin/ansible-lint` resolve against the active `CONDA_DIR`.
   - In `Makefile` `check:`:
     - Probe `GNU Make`, `OS` (`Darwin|Linux`), `brew` (required on BOTH `Darwin` and `Linux` for Conda bootstrap; check `/opt/homebrew/bin/brew`, `/usr/local/bin/brew`, `/home/linuxbrew/.linuxbrew/bin/brew`, `$$HOME/.linuxbrew/bin/brew`, and `command -v brew`; if missing print `MISSING: Homebrew (brew) is required` and increment `err=$$((err+1))`), `apt (Linux backend)` (on `Linux`, require `command -v apt`, else print `MISSING: apt is required` and increment `err=$$((err+1))`; on `Darwin`, print `n/a`), `conda` (check `command -v conda >/dev/null 2>&1 || [ -x "$(CONDA)" ]`), `ansible-core`, and `community.general`.
   - In `Makefile` `bootstrap:`:
     - Resolve `brew_bin` (`/opt/homebrew/bin/brew`, `/usr/local/bin/brew`, `/home/linuxbrew/.linuxbrew/bin/brew`, `$$HOME/.linuxbrew/bin/brew`, or `command -v brew`); fail with `"Error: Homebrew (brew) is required." >&2; exit 1` if missing. On `Linux`, verify `command -v apt >/dev/null 2>&1 || { echo "Error: apt is required on Linux." >&2; exit 1; }`.
     - Only install Conda when `if ! command -v conda >/dev/null 2>&1 && [ ! -x "$(CONDA)" ]; then`:
       - On `Darwin`: run `"$$brew_bin" install --cask miniforge || exit 1`.
       - On `Linux`: run `"$$brew_bin" install micromamba || exit 1`, locate `micromamba` (`"$$(dirname "$$brew_bin")/micromamba"` or `command -v micromamba`), and run `"$$mamba_bin" create -y -p "$(CONDA_DIR)" -c conda-forge --override-channels conda python=3.13 ansible-core ansible-lint pyyaml || exit 1`.
     - Remove all `curl -fsSL`, `Miniforge3-*.sh` download URLs, and `brew install curl` / `apt install -y curl` blocks from `Makefile` `bootstrap:`.
     - Run `"$(CONDA)" install -y -c conda-forge --override-channels python=3.13 ansible-core ansible-lint pyyaml || exit 1` and install `community.general`.
   - In `ansible/roles/homebrew/tasks/main.yml`: include `/home/linuxbrew/.linuxbrew/bin/brew` in the stat paths alongside `/opt/homebrew/bin/brew`, `/usr/local/bin/brew`, and `{{ devenv_home }}/.linuxbrew/bin/brew`.
   - In `ansible/roles/conda/tasks/main.yml`: probe `which conda` / `conda info --base` first plus candidate roots (`/opt/homebrew/Caskroom/miniforge/base`, `/usr/local/Caskroom/miniforge/base`, `{{ devenv_home }}/miniforge3`, `{{ devenv_home }}/miniforge`, `{{ devenv_home }}/mambaforge`, `{{ devenv_home }}/miniconda3`, `{{ devenv_home }}/anaconda3`, `/opt/miniforge3`, `/opt/conda`) so `make converge` reuses the existing Conda installation and never reinstalls when `conda` is already present. Only if no `conda` installation is found, install `miniforge` via `community.general.homebrew_cask` on `Darwin` or `micromamba` via `community.general.homebrew` + create the conda root on `Linux` (removing the `get_url` / `Miniforge3-*.sh` installer tasks). Ansible's `packages` role continues using one system package manager per OS (`brew` on macOS, `apt` on Linux).
2. FIX INTRO FORMATTING (`nvm`/node), ADD `## Getting Started`, AND UPDATE DIAGRAM/WORLD DOCS:
   - In `README.md` line 5, fix the broken `` `nvm`/node `` inline-code formatting and identify each core tool's role: `fish` (Terminal / Shell), `neovim` (Editor / IDE), `conda` (Python runtime & package manager), `nvm` (Node.js version manager).
   - Add a prominent `## Getting Started` section right after the intro paragraph and before `## Tool Chain & Execution Order` with 3 steps:
     - **1. Prerequisites**: `brew` (required on macOS and Linux for Conda bootstrap; also macOS system package manager) and `apt` (required on Debian/Ubuntu Linux for system packages), plus installing `make` and `git` if absent (`brew install make git` on macOS; `sudo apt update && sudo apt install -y make git` on Linux).
     - **2. Clone the Repository**: `git clone --bare <repo-url> dev-env/.git`, `git --git-dir=dev-env/.git config remote.origin.fetch "+refs/heads/*:refs/remotes/origin/*"`, `git --git-dir=dev-env/.git fetch origin`, `git --git-dir=dev-env/.git worktree add dev-env/main main`, `cd dev-env/main`.
     - **3. Kick Off the Environment (`make install`)**: State clearly that **`make install`** is the single command that kicks off and converges the entire dev-env pipeline (`make check` -> `make bootstrap` -> `make configure` -> `make converge`), alongside the individual stage commands.
   - Streamline `## Repository Setup & Worktree Architecture` and `## Commands & Workflow`, and update the Mermaid `flowchart TD` diagram, `Stage-by-Stage Execution` table, `holon-config/world/ruleset.md`, and `holon-config/world/constraints.md` so they accurately reflect `command -v conda` detection, `brew`-based Conda bootstrap (`make bootstrap` only), and single-backend Ansible convergence (`brew` on macOS, `apt` on Linux).
3. SHOW CATEGORY / PROGRAMMING LANGUAGE FOR EVERY TOOL IN `## Package & Tool Inventory` (`README.md`):
   - **### 1. Core CLI Packages (`devenv_packages_core`)**: Add a **`Category`** column (`| Logical Package | Category | macOS (\`brew\`) Formula | Linux (\`apt\`) Package | Stow Status | Description |`) for all 22 packages (`fish`: `Terminal / Shell`, `neovim`: `Editor / IDE`, `tmux`: `Terminal / Multiplexer`, `git`: `Version Control`, `gh`: `Git / GitHub`, `delta`: `Git / Diff`, `stow`: `Dotfiles / Symlinks`, `curl`: `Networking / HTTP`, `aria2`: `Networking / Download`, `autossh` & `openssh`: `Networking / SSH`, `iperf3`: `Networking / Benchmark`, `fd` & `ripgrep`: `Filesystem / Search`, `fzf`: `Terminal / Search`, `ncdu`: `Filesystem / Disk`, `rsync`: `Filesystem / Sync`, `tree`: `Filesystem / Navigation`, `jq`: `Data / JSON`, `htop` & `watch`: `System Monitoring`, `unzip`: `Archive / Compression`).
   - **### 2. Language Runtimes & Conda Tools**: Present a Markdown table (`| Tool / Runtime | Category / Language | Provisioned Via | Description |`) explicitly labeling `CPython 3.13` / `conda` (**Python — Runtime & Environment Manager**), `uv` (**Python — Package & Project Manager**), `ruff` (**Python — Linter & Formatter**), `pre-commit` (**Multi-Language — Git Hooks**), and `nvm.fish` + `Node.js 22.23.2` (**JavaScript / TypeScript — Node.js Runtime & Version Manager**).
   - **### 3. GNU Stow Packages & Config Variants (`devenv_package_variants`)**: Annotate category/language for `bash`, `conda`, `fish`, `tmux`, `zsh`, and `nvim-*` variants.
   - **### 4. Fish Shell Plugins (`fish_plugins`)**: Label `jorgebucaran/fisher` (**Terminal / Shell**), `reitzig/sdkman-for-fish@v2.1.0` (**Java / JVM**), and `jorgebucaran/nvm.fish` (**JavaScript / Node.js**).
   - **### 5. Neovim Plugins (`nvim-pack-lock.json`)**: Identify all 26 plugins as **Editor / IDE (Neovim / Lua)** with functional categories.
   - **### 6. macOS GUI Casks & Purged Unmanaged Packages**: Label `docker-desktop` (**Containers / Virtualization**) and `nvm`, `node` (**JavaScript / Node.js**).
4. UPDATE `tests/test_manifest.py` AND `tests/test_templating.py` AND VERIFY:
   - Update `tests/test_manifest.py` (and `tests/test_templating.py` where `conda` installer Jinja changed) to assert: `Makefile` probes `command -v conda` and `conda info --base`; `make check` requires `brew` (both OSes) and `apt` (Linux); `make bootstrap` installs Conda via `brew` when missing (`brew install --cask miniforge` on Darwin, `brew install micromamba` on Linux) without `curl`/`wget`/`urllib.request`/`apt-get`; `README.md` contains `## Getting Started`, documents `make install`, does not contain `` `nvm`/node ``, and includes the `Category` column and category/language attributions.
   - Verify with `uv run --extra test pytest -m "not network"`, `uv run ruff check .`, `uv run --extra test ansible-lint ansible/site.yml`, `npx prettier --check "**/*.md"`, and `make check`.

goal:

6. SHELLS (`dotfiles/fish/`, `dotfiles/bash/`, `dotfiles/zsh/`):
   - Remove personal host-specific paths (`$HOME/.docker/bin`, `$HOME/.lmstudio/bin`, `$HOME/.antigravity-ide/antigravity-ide/bin`) from `dotfiles/fish/.config/fish/config.fish`, `dotfiles/bash/.bashrc`, and `dotfiles/zsh/.zshrc`.
   - Remove custom `fish_greeting`, `EDITOR`, `VISUAL`, `PAGER`, and `GIT_PAGER` overrides from `dotfiles/fish/.config/fish/conf.d/00-devenv.fish` (retaining `set -g devenv_node_default_version 22.23.2`, `devenv_os`/`devenv_arch`, and `nvm_data`/`nvm_default_version`).

7. TESTS & VERIFICATION (`tests/test_manifest.py`, `tests/test_templating.py`):
   - Update any affected existing tests in `tests/test_manifest.py` or `tests/test_templating.py` (such as removed custom `.condarc` / `00-devenv.fish` lines) and add a manifest test verifying: `dotfiles/` contains no personal paths (`.lmstudio`, `.antigravity-ide`), `tmux.conf` and `nvim-minimal/init.lua` contain no custom keybindings/overrides, `nvim-kickstart` has no active `custom/plugins/*.lua` beyond `init.lua`, and `nvim-lazyvim/lua/plugins/example.lua` starts with `if true then return {} end`.

description: Robustly detect existing Conda and Ansible installations in Makefile and Ansible roles to prevent redundant installations, base environment reinstallation, or Python downgrades.
goal:
Ensure dev-env reliably detects, reuses, and never reinstalls or corrupts existing Conda or Ansible installations:
1. MAKEFILE ROBUST PATH & EXECUTABLE DETECTION:
   - Export extended PATH at the top of Makefile: `export PATH := /opt/homebrew/bin:/opt/homebrew/sbin:/usr/local/bin:/usr/local/sbin:/home/linuxbrew/.linuxbrew/bin:$(HOME)/.linuxbrew/bin:$(PATH)` so GNU Make recipes and subshells always find Homebrew/Linuxbrew tools.
   - Probe CONDA across `command -v conda` and standard locations (`/opt/homebrew/bin/conda`, `/usr/local/bin/conda`, `/opt/homebrew/Caskroom/miniforge/base/condabin/conda`, `/opt/homebrew/Caskroom/miniforge/base/bin/conda`, `/home/linuxbrew/.linuxbrew/bin/conda`, `$$HOME/.linuxbrew/bin/conda`, `$(HOME)/miniforge3/bin/conda`).
   - If CONDA executable exists, resolve CONDA_DIR dynamically via `$$CONDA info --base 2>/dev/null` (or directory fallback).
   - Probe PB (ansible-playbook), GALAXY (ansible-galaxy), and LINT (ansible-lint): if executable in `$(CONDA_DIR)/bin/`, reuse it; else if available on PATH via `command -v ansible-playbook` (e.g. `~/.local/bin/ansible-playbook`), reuse it; else fall back to `$(CONDA_DIR)/bin/ansible-playbook`.
   - In `bootstrap:` target:
     - Check if Conda is already present (`[ -x "$(CONDA)" ]` or `command -v conda >/dev/null 2>&1`). If present, echo `"Using existing Conda at $$(command -v conda 2>/dev/null || echo $(CONDA))..."` and do NOT run any Homebrew cask or micromamba install.
     - Check if `[ -x "$(PB)" ]`. If present, echo `"Using existing Ansible: $$( "$(PB)" --version 2>/dev/null | head -1 )"` and skip `conda install ... ansible-core`.
